items.title: GMM Pfaudler zooms 40% in Sep, hits 52-week high; what's driving the rally?
items.description: GMM Pfaudler surged 7% to ₹1,461.30 on the BSE in Friday's trade, and has nearly doubled or gained 99% from its 52-week low of ₹735.35 touched on June 11, 2026.

items.title: NSE IPO crosses halfway mark on 2nd day of bidding; check GMP & reviews
items.description: The NSE opened for subscription on Thursday and will remain open till Monday, September 21. The exchange has set a price band of ₹1,700-1,785 per share.

items.title: PVR Inox hits 52-week high, up 12% in 6 days post share buyback record date
items.description: On Friday, PVR Inox's share price quoted higher for the third straight trading day, soaring 7 per cent during the period. The ex-date for share buyback was September 04, 2026.

items.title: Tata stocks fall up to 8% amid rift over Tata Sons listing, Chandra's term
items.description: Tata Sons cleared N. Chandrasekaran's five-year reappointment and its proposed listing. Tata Trusts has opposed both the reappointment and listing, citing the Trusts' public-purpose role in the group.
